p: fourth year of Jehoiakim the son: That is, in the third year accomplished and in the beginning of the fourth: for though Nebuchadnezzar began to reign in the end of the third year of Jehoiakim's reign yet that year is not counted here because it was almost over, Da 1:1.
this day: Which was the fifth year and the ninth month of Jehoiakim's reign.
rising early and speaking: That is, I have spared no diligence or labour, Jer 7:13.

said: He shows that the prophets, wholly with one consent laboured to pull the people from those vices, which then reigned, that is, from idolatry and the vain confidence of men: for under these two all others were contained, 2Ki 17:13, Jer 18:11,35:15, Jon 3:8.
families of the north: The Chaldeans and all their power.
servant: So the wicked and Satan himself are God's servants, because he makes them serve him by constraint and turns that which they do out of malice to his honour and glory.
around: As the Philistines, Ammonites, Egyptians and others.
millstones: Meaning that bread and all things that would serve to their feasts would be taken away.

seventy years are accomplished: This revelation was for the confirmation of his prophecy because he told them of the time that they would enter and remain in captivity, 2Ch 36:22, Ezr 1:1, Jer 29:10, Da 9:2.
the king of Babylon: For seeing the judgment began at his own house, the enemies must be punished most grievously, Eze 9:6, 1Pe 4:17.
served by them also: That is of the Babylonians as in Jer 27:7.

Take the wine cup of this: Signifying the extreme affliction that God had appointed for everyone, Ps 75:8, Isa 51:17 and this cup which the wicked drink, is more bitter than that which he gives to his children, for he measures the one by mercy, and the other by justice.
as it is this day: For now it begins and will so continue till it is accomplished.
of Uz: Read Job 1:1.
Ashkelon: Which were cities of the Philistines.
Edom: Edom is here taken for the whole country and Uz for a part of it.
isles which are beyond the sea: As Greece, Italy and the rest of those countries.
Dedan: These were people of Arabia which came of Dedan the son of Abraham and Keturah.
desert: For there were two countries so named, the one called plentiful and the other barren, or desert.
Sheshach shall drink after them: That is of Babylon, as in Jer 51:41.
I begin to bring evil on: That is Jerusalem, read Jer 25:12.
the slain of the LORD shall: They who are slain at the Lord's appointment.
ye shepherds: You that are chief rulers, and governors.
pleasant vessel: Which are most easily broken.
shepherds shall have no way to: It will not help them to seek to flee.
